definition.Sql:
SELECT TOP (1)
    BranchID_PK AS branchId,
    BranchName AS branchName,
    BranchAddressLine1 AS branchAddressLine1,
    BranchAddressLine2 AS branchAddressLine2,
    BranchAddressLine3 AS branchAddressLine3,
    BranchPhone AS phone,
    BranchEmailAddress AS email
FROM MyCompany.Config_Branchs
WHERE IsCurrentBranch = 1
ORDER BY BranchID_PK;
